g.text: Context takeover: crash or reboot -> fence -> confirmed absence -> eligibility -> seed or native resume -> reconcile -> release
read every fence first; boot_id changed = absence evidence
up(): request restore per registered session
compare-only (profile_pin, fragment digest on the same host)
compare pins and posture; binding rev; grants;
auth readiness; runtime resume probe; goal revision current
notice refused{reason}: operator decides (accepting drift = new operation, rebuild)
The restore path ends here: no rebind,
[native_resume allowed (same runtime range, home, pin, transcript digest, exclusive custody)]
goal revisions, every item by its verdict
items keep their own verdict labels)
reconcile unknown deliveries (input markers in transcript)
rebind io_bindings (same handles, binding rev rechecked)
id claims: duplicates return the old receipt
goal provider nudges resume via enqueue (goal ledger revision)
